title: Pagination returns 9 items per page instead of 10
context:
def get_page(items, page, size=10):
    start = page * size
    return items[start:start + size - 1]

Users report every page shows 9 results. PAGE_SIZE is 10 everywhere else.

title: Tags from one request leak into other requests
context:
def add_tags(item, tags=[]):
    tags.append(item.default_tag)
    item.tags = tags
    return item

Intermittently, items get tags belonging to previously processed items. Only happens under load, resets on restart.
